content: उच्छ्वस् €2 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To breathe, live; आत्मेच्छया न शक्यमुच्छ्वसितुमपि <ls>K. 175</ls>; <ls>Ve. 5. 15</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 72</ls>; अनुच्छ्वस्य without breathing, in one breath. .²2 To take heart or courage, cheer up, revive, breathe a sigh of relief; नाद्याप्युच्छ्वसिति <ls>U. 3</ls>, <ls n="U.">7</ls>; त्वत्सन्निधावुच्छ्वसितीव चेतः <ls>Ki. 3. 8</ls> is delighted; <ls>Śi. 18. 58</ls>; <ls>Ratn. 4</ls>; दिगन्तः <ls>Ki. 9. 21</ls>. .²3 To open, bloom (as a lotus); नोच्छ्वसिति तपनकिरणैः (कुमुदम्) <ls>V. 3. 16</ls>; <ls>M. 2. 11</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 58</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">11. 15</ls>. .²4 To take a deep breath, pant, sigh deeply; निष्पिष्टः कोष्णमुच्छ्वसन् <ls>Bk. 6. 120</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 55</ls>. .²5 To throb, heave, palpitate. .²6 To be loosened or relaxed. . --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to breathe. .²2 To console, cheer up, delight, give rest; उच्छ्वासयन्त्यः श्लथबन्धनानि; <ls>Ṛs. 6. 8</ls>; <ls>U. 3</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 34</ls>. .²3 To loosen, relax, disjoin; दशमुखभुजोच्छ्वासितप्रस्थसन्धिः <ls>Me. 60</ls>.
